interpretation.permanentPickupSemantics: m_bIsPermanentPickup plus modifier_permanent_pickup and explicit modifier-value rows constitute strong local-resource evidence for permanent stat effects.
interpretation.bridgeSemantics: Bridge Powerups are represented by temporary pickup records with dedicated modifier classes and script-value effects.
interpretation.sourceTrace: Exact VData references identify resource-level producers/parents but do not prove replay-time acquisition.
interpretation.urnCorrection: Golden-idol naming is not treated as Golden-Statue evidence when the underlying resource carries explicit Urn identifiers.
interpretation.lionStatue: The lion-statue record is not assumed to grant permanent stats unless a direct permanent-pickup reference is found.
interpretation.laterReplayLayer: PlayerState(t) requires replay reconstruction of which player actually acquired each effect and when.
